title: Material Blend 4-Mix Duo #27 (이레즈미+뱀비늘+보태니컬+스테인드글라스 / 보태니컬+금박+UV네온+뱀비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
